title: 第12章 初入
content_zh:
第12章初入
许景明吃惊看着周围，这是一片虚幻空间，仅有一名青衫男子微笑说道：“我是你的游戏引领者，在你学会所有功能后，我便会消失。”
“游戏引领者？”
许景明看看对方，又忍不住摸了摸自己，肌肉紧实，双手练拳的伤疤都有，又踢了踢腿，“这和我现实中的肉身一模一样，腿伤都有。”
“虚拟头盔，可以扫描现实肉身，确保百分百虚拟。”青衫男子微笑道，“不要怀疑虚拟头盔的技术。”
许景明暗惊：“现在医院的扫描，的确可以让全身每一处都无法隐藏，扫描可达到细胞级。但那都是昂贵的机器，现在人手一个的虚拟头盔，科技技术都这么厉害？也对，蓝星联盟耗费漫长时间才攻克了虚拟头盔制造技术。”
“许景明你好，在生命进化世界，你的游戏昵称自动锁定为‘许景明’。”青衫男子说道。
“只允许用真名？”许景明惊讶。
“是的。”青衫男子点头，“这游戏虚拟世界，一共分为三大空间，分别是个人空间、任务空间、战斗空间。其中任务空间暂未开放。你能使用的，仅有个人空间和战斗空间。”
“个人空间和战斗空间？”许景明好奇。
“请选择你的个人空间位置。”青衫男子一挥手，一旁便显现出庞大的地图，“这座世界的面积是蓝星的三千六百倍，你可以选择任意一处无主之处，红色标识代表已经有主。”
许景明查看着地图，双手一拉，地图便迅速放大。
“好大的游戏世界。”许景明很快选择了一处景色秀美的雪山山顶，山顶处也有冰湖，“确定。”
“个人空间，锁定。”青衫男子点头，“之后每次登录，你便会直接出现在个人空间。”
周围场景模糊，青衫男子带着许景明迅速坠落，坠落向那边浩瀚世界。
浩瀚的游戏世界，此刻无数流星坠落，正是蓝星的无数玩家。
雪山山顶，一座冰湖旁，有一座小木屋出现，许景明和青衫男子也出现在木屋旁。
“木屋，便是你的住处。”青衫男子指着木屋，“木屋周围百米，都是你的领地。任何人没有你的允许，是无法进入木屋百米范围内。”
许景明一眼看到，冰湖另一边，也有木屋降落，也有一名女玩家和红袍女子。
嗖嗖嗖，眨眼功夫，冰湖周围已经有五座木屋了，只是隔着至少两三百米，勉强遥遥看到彼此。

“雪山山顶还真冷，温度都模拟的这么真实？”许景明立即推开木屋的门，走进屋内，关上屋门才觉得好了不少。
透过窗户看着冰湖场景，许景明不由感慨：“环境是真美，100%虚拟，真是匪夷所思。现实中想要在如此美丽环境下，建造一处住宅可不容易，就是这木屋小了些。”
“你可以选择购买更大住宅，点开个人面板，在这里可以购买。”青衫男子指引。
许景明了然，看着个人面板上浮现的详细介绍。
“只要花钱，住处可以变得更大？一百块、一千块、一万块……最高是一千万？一千万这个，可以在云层上购买住处？”许景明吃惊。
云层上的一座仙府，可俯瞰大地，估计有富豪舍得买。
“买个一万块的。”许景明轻轻一点，自己如今所在的小木屋立即变化，化作了一座上千平米建筑面积的中式宅子，院子也有两三千平米，院落边沿周围百米范围是许景明的领地。
“黎渺渺正在联系你……”许景明收到提示。
“渺渺。”许景明接通联系。
“景明，这游戏世界太真实了，你试着邀请我，我应该可以直接出现在你那。”黎渺渺兴奋道。
一旁青衫男子也介绍道：“好友名单的初始设置，是将你通讯录、社交圈、银行汇款名单所有人，都暂定为好友。你可直接联系他们。必须你邀请，他们同意，他们才可以来到这里。当然他们离开就无需你同意了，可瞬间回归个人空间。”
许景明看着好友名单：“我都不知道我认识这么多人，这是小区门口卖水果的大妈吧。”
许景明试着对爸、妈、爷爷、黎渺渺以及女友的父母，全部邀请了一个遍。
很快……
一个又一个人影，接连出现在院门外。
“景明邀请我们来的。”
“这里景色不错啊，就是有些冷。”
许老爷子、许父许母、黎父黎母、黎渺渺哆哆嗦嗦出现在院门处，许景明则立即去开门。
“景明啊，你这怎么是个大宅子？”许洪跺跺脚，走进来，“我那却是个小木屋。”
“要花钱的。”一旁的许老爷子衣服变化，套上了羽绒服，“个人面板有很多功能，我刚才看了下，就摸索了很多功能。购买衣服、宅子等各种物品，还有观战平台、练武场等各种功能。”

“老爸，你玩得溜啊。”许洪笑道。
“有这么多功能吗？”黎父黎母都惊讶。
“学进化法，必须去练武场。”许老爷子非常熟练，“学完之后，身体进化，就可以去战斗空间！进行各种对战，进化得更强的人类，以及战斗技巧更强的，在对战时就有优势。蓝星联盟，应该是为了搜集我们进化后，身体变化的数据，为推演新的进化法做准备吧，不过能活到一百六十岁，我就很满足了，哈哈，真没想到，老了，还能有这样的大机遇。活得久就是好啊，能赶上这个好时代啊。”
“观战平台是什么？”黎渺渺点开查看，“观看直播，玩家可以选择将自己练武场景，还有战斗场景进行直播？爷爷，你太厉害了，游戏世界刚刚开放，你就弄明白这么多。”
“我玩手机游戏那会儿，十八岁就拿到了Fmvp，退役后当游戏主播又那么多年，游戏这些套路，我闭着眼睛都能猜出来。”许老爷子笑眯眯道，“不过这游戏世界，还真是了不起。个人空间就存在很多操作性，相隔万里也能面对面一起喝茶聊天，可以进行工作学习，学校都可以在这里教学生了……论社交，彻底碾压原本的社交软件了。”
“嗯，视频聊天软件，也没法和这游戏世界相比。”黎辰安点头。
“还有直播，过去的直播平台几乎都要完了，必须得立即转行。”许老爷子感慨，“我活了这么多年，看到过科技对社会的一次次改变，但这一次对整个社会改变太大了。”
黎辰安笑道：“许老爷子，蓝星联盟既然做了，预案都肯定准备了很多套。我们这些普通人就不用想太多了，至少对我们普通人而言，这是一次前所未有的机遇。”
“我们还是赶紧练进化法吧。”许洪笑道，“很多人估计都开始练了。”
“走，赶紧练。”许老爷子哗的凭空消失不见，直接回归个人空间了。
“走。”
一个个消散不见。
“我回去了。”黎渺渺最后一个离去，消散回归个人空间。
许景明则是点开个人面板，仔细研究个人空间的功能。
“个人空间内，可以读书，这里有义务教育的所有教科书，很多教辅材料，乃至一些科学前沿的材料。”许景明看着，随意点了几本物理书籍，他大学学的就是物理。
一本本书籍浮现，出现在书架上。
“这虚拟游戏世界，不仅仅只是游戏，可以召开会议、见朋友乃至读书工作学习，甚至搞科研。”许景明惊叹，有太多功能了。
“去练武场。”许景明点开练武场，选择进入。
眼前场景变幻。
这是一座青山绿水的峡谷，许景明看着周围，景色是真漂亮。

“这里是练武场。”青衫男子说道，“练武场可以辅助你训练，比如练基因进化法，锻炼战斗技巧。这里也有各种陪练，你可以设定陪练的不同实力，你也可以自由调整练武场环境。”
许景明轻轻点了一下面板，立即有十本书册漂浮着缓缓落下，这些书册封面都是汉字。
“十本进化法，请先仔细研读。”青衫男子说道。
许景明开始安心
十本进化法，有五本男性进化法，五本女性进化法。当然蓝星之大，无奇不有，也有一些人比较特殊，偏偏适合异性进化法。
content_en:
Chapter 12 First Entry
Xu Jingming looked around in surprise. This was an illusory space. Only a man in a green shirt smiled and said: "I am your game leader. After you learn all the functions, I will disappear."
"Game leader?"
Xu Jingming looked at the other person and couldn't help but touch himself. His muscles were tight and there were scars from boxing on both hands. He kicked his legs again and said, "This is exactly the same as my real body, even with leg injuries."
"The virtual helmet can scan the real body to ensure that it is 100% virtual." The man in green shirt smiled and said, "Don't doubt the technology of the virtual helmet."
Xu Jingming was secretly shocked: "The scans in hospitals now can indeed make every part of the body invisible, and the scans can reach the cellular level. But they are expensive machines. Now everyone has a virtual helmet, and the technology is so powerful? That's right. It took the Blue Star Alliance a long time to conquer the virtual helmet manufacturing technology."
"Hello Xu Jingming, in the world of life evolution, your game nickname is automatically locked to 'Xu Jingming'." said the man in green shirt.
"Only real names are allowed?" Xu Jingming was surprised.
"Yes." The man in green shirt nodded, "The virtual world of this game is divided into three major spaces, namely personal space, mission space, and battle space. The mission space is not open yet. The only ones you can use are personal space and battle space."
"Personal space and combat space?" Xu Jingming was curious.
"Please choose your personal space location." The man in green shirt waved his hand, and a huge map appeared on the side. "The area of this world is 3,600 times that of Blue Star. You can choose any unowned place. The red mark means that it already has an owner."
Xu Jingming looked at the map, and with a pull of his hands, the map quickly zoomed in.
"What a big game world." Xu Jingming quickly chose the top of a snow-capped mountain with beautiful scenery. There was also a glacial lake at the top of the mountain. "Okay."
"Personal space, lock it." The man in blue shirt nodded, "Every time you log in from now on, you will appear directly in your personal space."
The surrounding scene was blurry, and the man in green shirt quickly fell with Xu Jingming into the vast world over there.
In the vast game world, countless meteors are falling at this moment, which are countless players of Blue Star.
On the top of the snow mountain, next to an icy lake, a small wooden house appeared. Xu Jingming and the man in green shirt also appeared next to the wooden house.
"The wooden house is your residence." The man in green shirt pointed at the wooden house, "The 100 meters around the wooden house are your territory. No one can enter within 100 meters of the wooden house without your permission."
Xu Jingming saw at a glance that there was a wooden house landing on the other side of the ice lake, and there was also a female player and a woman in red robes.
Swish, swish, in the blink of an eye, there were already five wooden houses around the ice lake, but they were separated by at least two to three hundred meters, and they could barely see each other from a distance.
"It's really cold at the top of the snow mountain, and the temperature is simulated so realistically?" Xu Jingming immediately opened the door of the wooden house, walked into the house, and felt much better after closing the door.
Looking at the ice lake scene through the window, Xu Jingming couldn't help but sigh: "The environment is so beautiful, 100% virtual, it's incredible. In reality, it's not easy to build a house in such a beautiful environment, but this wooden house is a little small."
"You can choose to buy a larger house. Click on the personal panel and you can buy it here." The man in green shirt guided.
Xu Jingming understood clearly and looked at the detailed introduction that appeared on his personal panel.
"As long as you spend money, can your residence become bigger? One hundred yuan, one thousand yuan, ten thousand yuan... The highest is ten million yuan? With ten million yuan, can you buy a residence on the clouds?" Xu Jingming was surprised.
There is a fairy mansion on the clouds, overlooking the earth. There are probably rich people who are willing to buy it.
"Buy one for 10,000 yuan." Xu Jingming clicked lightly, and the small wooden house he was in immediately changed, turning into a Chinese-style house with a building area of ​​over a thousand square meters, and a yard of two to three thousand square meters. Around the edge of the courtyardThe 100-meter range is Xu Jingming’s territory.
"Li Miaomiao is contacting you..." Xu Jingming received the prompt.
"Miaomiao." Xu Jingming connected.
"Jing Ming, this game world is too real. If you try to invite me, I should be able to appear directly at your place." Li Miaomiao said excitedly.
The man in green shirt on the side also introduced: "The initial setting of the friend list is to temporarily designate everyone in your address book, social circle, and bank transfer list as friends. You can contact them directly. They must be invited by you and they agree before they can come here. Of course, if they leave, you do not need your consent, and they can return to their personal space instantly."
Xu Jingming looked at the list of friends: "I didn't know I knew so many people. This is the aunt who sells fruit at the gate of the community."
Xu Jingming tried to invite his father, mother, grandfather, Li Miaomiao and his girlfriend's parents.
Soon...
One after another, figures appeared outside the courtyard gate.
"Jing Ming invited us here."
"The scenery here is nice, but it's a bit cold."
Mr. Xu, Father Xu, Mother Xu, Father Li, Mother Li, and Li Miaomiao tremblingly appeared at the courtyard gate, and Xu Jingming immediately went to open the door.
"Jing Ming, why is this a big house of yours?" Xu Hong stomped his feet and walked in, "But mine is a small wooden house."
"It costs money." Mr. Xu on the side changed his clothes and put on a down jacket. "The personal panel has many functions. I just looked at it and explored many functions. It can purchase various items such as clothes and houses, as well as various functions such as a viewing platform and a martial arts training ground."
"Dad, you are having fun." Xu Hong said with a smile.
"Does it have so many functions?" Li's father and Li's mother were both surprised.
"To learn evolution, you must go to the martial arts training ground." Mr. Xu is very skilled. "After learning, your body evolves, and you can go to the battle space! In various battles, humans who have evolved more, and those with stronger combat skills will have an advantage in the battle. The Blue Star Alliance should be for In order to collect data on the changes in our body after evolution, I will prepare for the deduction of new evolutionary methods. But I will be very satisfied if I can live to be 160 years old. Haha, I never thought that I would have such a great opportunity when I am old. It is good to live long and catch up with this good era. "
"What is the viewing platform?" Li Miaomiao clicked to check. "Watching the live broadcast, players can choose to live broadcast their own martial arts training scenes and battle scenes? Grandpa, you are so awesome. The game world has just opened, and you have figured out so much."
"When I was playing mobile games, I got FMVP at the age of eighteen. After retiring, I worked as a game anchor for so many years. I can guess the game routines with my eyes closed." Mr. Xu said with a smile, "But this game world is really amazing. There is a lot of maneuverability in personal space. We can drink tea and chat face to face even though we are thousands of miles away. We can work and study, and schools can teach students here... In terms of social interaction, it has completely crushed the original social software."
"Well, video chat software can't compare with this game world." Li Chenan nodded.
"There are also live broadcasts. The previous live broadcast platforms are almost dead, and we must change careers immediately." Mr. Xu lamented, "I have lived for so many years and have seen technology change society again and again, but this time it has changed the entire society too much."
Li Chenan smiled and said: "Mr. Xu, since the Blue Star Alliance has made it, it must have prepared many plans. We ordinary people don't have to think too much. At least for us ordinary people, this is an unprecedented opportunity."
"We'd better practice the evolution method quickly." Xu Hong said with a smile, "Many people have probably started practicing."
"Let's go, practice quickly." Mr. Xu disappeared out of thin air and returned directly to his personal space.
"Let's go."
One by one they disappeared.
"I'm going back." Li Miaomiao was the last oneLeave, dissipate and return to your personal space.
Xu Jingming clicked on the personal panel and carefully studied the functions of personal space.
"You can read in your personal space. There are all the textbooks for compulsory education, many teaching aids, and even some cutting-edge scientific materials." Xu Jingming looked at it and clicked on a few physics books at random. He studied physics in college.
Books appeared one after another on the bookshelf.
"This virtual game world is not just about games. You can hold meetings, meet friends, study, work and study, and even do scientific research." Xu Jingming marveled that there are so many functions.
"Go to the martial arts training ground." Xu Jingming clicked on the martial arts training ground and chose to enter.
The scene before my eyes changes.
This is a canyon with green mountains and green water. Xu Jingming looked around and the scenery was so beautiful.
"This is a martial arts training ground." The man in green shirt said. "The martial arts training ground can assist you in training, such as practicing genetic evolution and practicing combat skills. There are also various sparring partners here. You can set the different strengths of the sparring partners, and you can also freely adjust the martial arts field environment."
Xu Jingming tapped the panel lightly, and ten books immediately floated and slowly fell down. The covers of these books were all Chinese characters.
"Please read the ten evolutionary methods carefully first." said the man in green shirt.
Xu Jingming began to feel relieved
There are ten books on evolution, including five books on male evolution and five books on female evolution. Of course, the size of the Blue Star is full of surprises, and there are also some people who are special and are suitable for the evolution method of the opposite sex.
